formatter.description: What formatted it: `prettier` or `biome` (the project's, or the pinned one), `server` (the language server's textDocument/formatting, named in `server`), or `none` when nothing can format this file.

server.description: The language server that formatted it (its servers.json id), when `formatter` is `server`.

applied.description: Whether the document changed (false when it was already formatted, or the formatter failed).

edits.description: Text edits applied (0 when it was already formatted).

message.description: Why nothing was applied: the formatter's error (also written to the Output window), or why no formatter applies.
